sections.overview: Vanga Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Vanga Bhasma is calcined to form a powder. It is prepared from the metal Tin. Tin goes through all the steps of Bhasma preparation which makes it super fine as a result. It is nourishing and strengthening. This medicine is very effective in treating mental fatigue, worm infestation and sexual disorders also. This formulation should be properly prepared as raw Vanga Bhasma has severe side effects. It is extremely beneficial in treating male and female reproductive diseases, adrenal gland disorders.
sections.ingredients:
Purified tin metal 
 Aloe Vera juice 

 Method of Preparation 
 Take the pieces of purified tin and put them in an iron pan and let it melt. Add powdered Achyranthes aspera and Ficus religiosa and mix well. Now add Aloe Vera juice to this mixture and prepare round, flat discs. Put these discs in a tightly sealed container and heat them at a high temperature. Repeat this process seven times to get the final product.
sections.dosage:
125- 250 mg twice daily after meals. 
 It can be taken with Tinospora concoction, honey, turmeric, clarified butter. 
 Pungent products like chilies, tamarind etc. should be shunned.

sections.contraindications:
Over dosage can cause severe gastritis. 
 It should be prescribed by your doctor. Self-medication is strictly discouraged. 
 It should be avoided by pregnant women, lactating mothers and kids.

fullContent:
Vanga Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasamrit 
 Introduction 
 Vanga Bhasma is calcined to form a powder. It is prepared from the metal Tin. Tin goes through all the steps of Bhasma preparation which makes it super fine as a result. It is nourishing and strengthening. This medicine is very effective in treating mental fatigue, worm infestation and sexual disorders also. This formulation should be properly prepared as raw Vanga Bhasma has severe side effects. It is extremely beneficial in treating male and female reproductive diseases, adrenal gland disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified tin metal 
 Aloe Vera juice 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take the pieces of purified tin and put them in an iron pan and let it melt. Add powdered Achyranthes aspera and Ficus religiosa and mix well. Now add Aloe Vera juice to this mixture and prepare round, flat discs. Put these discs in a tightly sealed container and heat them at a high temperature. Repeat this process seven times to get the final product. 
 Dosage 
 
 125- 250 mg twice daily after meals. 
 It can be taken with Tinospora concoction, honey, turmeric, clarified butter. 
 Pungent products like chilies, tamarind etc. should be shunned. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Urinary tract disorders 
 Halitosis 
 Anovulation 
 Amenorrhea 
 Leucorrhea 
 Dysmenorrhea 
 Polyuria 
 Menopause 
 Male reproductive system ailments 
 Worm infestation 
 Helps in the formation of RBCs 
 Pain reliever 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage can cause severe gastritis. 
 It should be prescribed by your doctor. Self-medication is strictly discouraged. 
 It should be avoided by pregnant women, lactating mothers and kids. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
